description: Choose a city and plan daily routes. Add another city when your trip takes you farther. Keep track of packing, expenses, check-ins and photos. Photos stay on your device. Optional AI title suggestions use event times and coordinates.
release_notes: See the city route for check-in and check-out. Move a hotel or sight to another day and keep browsing in its city when the route allows. The map remembers your last place. Tap a shared pin to switch between nearby results and stops already on your day.
